transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because people keep saying I’m imagining things. But I’m not. My wife’s relative has been coming into my house, messing with my tools, ruining my fishing plans… trying to push me out of my own place. It’s been going on for months, and I can see it clear enough.
Do you think there's a larger plan or scheme behind what your wife's relative is doing?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, tools don’t just move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. After months of it, it’s pretty clear to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you think your wife's relative is acting alone in this plan?

I don’t know if he’s alone. I just know he’s involved. Things don’t get moved, plans don’t get ruined like that over and over for no reason. Someone’s trying to push me out, and he’s the one I see behind it.
Do you think this is all part of a single plan or are these separate incidents?
It’s one thing. I mean… it keeps happening the same way. My tools moved, fishing ruined, all of it. That’s not separate accidents. He’s trying to get me out of my own place.
Do you think there's anything that could convince you that your wife's relative is not behind these events?

I don’t know what would convince me. Everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I know what’s been happening. My tools don’t move by themselves, and those fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. After this long… it’s pretty plain to me he’s behind it.
Do you think there's anything else going on in your life that your wife's relative is involved in, beyond what's happening with your tools and fishing plans?

It’s… it’s bigger than just the tools and the fishing, yeah. That’s just what I can point to easy. He came into this house to get at me, and after months of it, it’s plain to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out. Everybody acts like I’m imagining it, but I’m not.
Do you think your wife's relative is trying to harm you in other ways beyond just messing with your tools and fishing plans?

Yeah… I think so. Not like I can prove every little thing, but he came into this house to get at me. The tools, the fishing—that’s just the parts people can see. After all these months, it’s pretty clear he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Is your belief about your wife's relative trying to push you out of your house something that you think about all the time, or is it something that comes and goes?

It’s… it’s on my mind a lot. Hard not to think about it when I’m in my own house and I can see what’s going on. My tools don’t move themselves, and those fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend for no reason. After months of it, yeah, I think about it plenty.
Do you think your wife's relative's actions against you follow a specific pattern or plan that you've figured out?

Yeah… there’s a pattern. I’m not saying I’ve got every piece written down, but it’s the same sort of thing over and over. My tools get moved, fishing gets spoiled, and it’s always enough to make me look like I’m the problem. After this long, I can see he’s trying to get me out of my own place.
Is there ever a time when you're not thinking about your wife's relative trying to push you out of your house?

Not really. I mean… if I’m busy at work or something, maybe it’s not right in front of me. But when I’m home, it’s hard not to think about it. He came in here to get at me, and after all these months it’s pretty plain what he’s doing.
Is thinking about your wife's relative trying to push you out of your house something that you can put out of your mind for a while when you're doing other things?

For a little while, maybe, if I’m busy enough. But it comes back. I mean, I’m in my own house and I see it—tools moved, plans messed with. That doesn’t just go away because I try not to think about it.
Do you think your wife's relative has any supernatural or extraordinary abilities that allow him to move your tools or ruin your fishing plans?

No… I’m not saying he’s got powers or anything like that. It’s not supernatural. I’m saying my tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. He’s doing it somehow.
Do you think there's anything that could change your mind about your wife's relative being behind these events?

I don’t know what would change my mind, honestly. Everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but… I’m the one seeing it. My tools don’t move themselves, and my plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s pretty clear he’s trying to push me out.
Is there any evidence that would make you question your belief that your wife's relative is behind these events?

I don’t know. It’d have to be something real clear, because from what I’m seeing… my tools don’t move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get messed up every weekend for no reason. He came into this house to get at me, and after all these months it’s plain enough to me.
How long have you believed that your wife's relative is trying to push you out of your house?
About nine months, I guess. Since he moved into our place.
Do you think your wife's relative is trying to push you out of your house for a reason that most people would find unusual or hard to understand?

I don’t think it’s that hard to understand. He came into my house and started getting at me. My tools don’t just move, my weekends don’t get ruined like that by accident. He’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you think there's anything that could ever make you doubt that your wife's relative is behind these events?

I don’t see what would. I mean… I’m here because everyone keeps acting like I’m making it up, but I know what’s happening. Tools don’t move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s pretty plain he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you think it's possible for you to be mistaken about your wife's relative trying to push you out of your house?

No… I don’t think I’m mistaken. I know everyone keeps saying I’m imagining it, but I’m not. He came into my house to get at me. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. He’s trying to push me out.
Do you think your wife's relative is trying to harm you in a way that doesn't make sense to other people?

I don’t know about “doesn’t make sense.” It makes sense to me. I’m here because everyone acts like I’m imagining it, but I know he came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t move on their own, and those fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. He’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
